errors.connectionLost: Lost the connection to the server. Please try again — your work in progress is not lost, it keeps running on the server.
errors.taskTimeout: The setup is taking unusually long. Please try again.

taskProgress.runsOnServer: Running on the server — you can leave this window alone

choose.title: Let’s set up your Chrlit
choose.subtitle: How do you want to start?

website.title: I have a website
website.body: The AI analyzes your website and sets everything up automatically.

manual.title: I have no website
manual.body: You answer a few questions and the AI sets everything up for you.

input.title: Enter your website
input.subtitle: The AI analyzes your brand and sets everything up for you.

manual.title: Tell us about your business
manual.subtitle: A few questions and the AI sets everything up for you.
manual.descriptionLabel: What do you do? Describe your business
manual.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. A cosy café in the centre of Brno, we roast our own coffee and make homemade desserts...
manual.productsPlaceholder: e.g. Espresso, Cappuccino, Cheesecake, Brunch menu
manual.toneLabel: How do you want to communicate?

analyzing.title: The AI is analyzing your website
analyzing.body: Reading the content, learning the brand, preparing tailored questions.

questions.title: Follow-up questions
questions.body: Based on the analysis of your website we have a few follow-up questions.

building.title: Generating the configuration
building.body: Building the brand voice, content pillars and visual style.

review.title: Review the configuration
review.body: Go through the sections. If something is wrong, click 👎 and write what to change.

factCheck.title: Claim check
factCheck.body: The AI makes up numbers and years as fluently as it copies them. We already have the facts from your website; this decides what happens to a claim they do not support. Neither end of the slider lets a lie through — it only changes who resolves it.

off.label: Off
off.detail: No check runs. The AI is still forbidden to invent details, but nobody checks it.

safe.label: Careful
safe.detail: Fixes everything it dares to, including headlines in the image. Safest — and sometimes dullest.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.detail: Fixes the post text; in the headline it only swaps a wrong number for the right one. An unsupported headline is left alone and flagged for you.

bold.label: Bold
bold.detail: Rewrites nothing. The text keeps its punch and every risky claim comes to you flagged for a decision.

card.feedbackPlaceholder: What is wrong? What do you want to change?
card.maxRefines: Max. number of edits — fine-tune it in Settings

saving.title: Saving the configuration
saving.body: Creating the bucket, linking the account...

firstplan.title: Preparing your first content plan...
firstplan.body: Putting together topics and hooks tailored to your brand — based on what already works for you on Instagram.
firstplan.note: Your weekly plan will be waiting in the dashboard

bootstrap.title: Starting the sample content preparation...
bootstrap.body: Filling the topic bank and queuing 3 sample posts. They finish generating on the server — you do not have to wait for them.
bootstrap.note: Sample posts are generating in the background — you will find them in Posts

reonboard.title: Configuration updated! 🔄
reonboard.body: Your new configuration is saved. All future posts will use the new settings.

new.title: Everything is ready! 🎉
new.body: Your approved configuration is saved. You can start generating.
